heroSectionData.title: The Attorney
heroSectionData.name: António Tavares Júnior
heroSectionData.description: Specialized in immigration, Portuguese nationality and processes with AIMA and SEF. Ensure your residence, citizenship and regularization with safety and efficiency.

aboutSectionData.name: António Tavares Júnior
aboutSectionData.description:
António Tavares Júnior is a lawyer specializing in Immigration Law, with extensive experience in providing legal assistance to foreigners who wish to establish residency in Portugal.
With a solid educational background and in-depth knowledge of Portuguese and European immigration legislation, António has dedicated his career to facilitating the integration process for people of various nationalities in Portuguese territory.

His practice covers all areas of Immigration Law, from obtaining visas and residence permits to Portuguese nationality processes, family reunification, and administrative appeals before AIMA (Agency for Immigration, Mobility, and Asylum).

António Tavares Júnior stands out for his personalized and humanized approach, understanding that each case has unique aspects that require tailored solutions. His commitment is to transform the complex immigration process into a clearer and more accessible journey for his clients.

With a track record of successful cases and recognition in the legal field, António remains a reference for those seeking safe and effective guidance on immigration matters in Portugal.

servicesSectionData.title: Services
servicesSectionData.description: We offer a wide range of services to help you with your immigration needs.

services.title: Residence Authorization
topics: Obtaining visas and residence permits for work, study, or investment.
Regularization of immigrants already in Portugal.
Advisory services for Golden Visa and other special regimes.
services.description: Obtaining visas and residence permits for work, study, or investment. Our specialized immigration team can help you navigate the process of obtaining residence authorization in Portugal. Additionally, we offer advisory services for obtaining the Golden Visa and other special regimes, ensuring you have all the necessary information for a smooth transition.

services.title: Portuguese Nationality and Citizenship
topics: Acquisition of citizenship by descent (Portuguese parents, grandparents, or great-grandparents).
Naturalization through residence time in Portugal.
Citizenship for spouses of Portuguese citizens.
Citizenship for children of Portuguese citizens.
Citizenship for parents of Portuguese citizens.
services.description: Acquisition of citizenship by descent (Portuguese parents, grandparents, or great-grandparents). Our team can help you understand the requirements and processes involved in acquiring Portuguese citizenship, whether by descent or naturalization. Additionally, we provide guidance for spouses, children, and parents of Portuguese citizens seeking to obtain citizenship.

services.title: Family Reunification
topics: Processes to bring family members to live legally in Portugal.
Advisory services to ensure proof of family ties.
services.description: Processes to bring family members to live legally in Portugal. Our team can help you understand the processes and requirements for family reunification in Portugal, ensuring you have all the necessary information for a smooth family reunion.

services.title: Appeals and Contests
topics: Defense against visa or residence permit denials.
Representation in cases of expulsion or deportation.
Administrative appeals before AIMA (Agency for Immigration, Mobility, and Asylum) and SEF.
services.description: Defense against visa or residence permit denials. Our team can help you defend your rights in cases of visa or residence permit denials, as well as represent you in cases of expulsion or deportation. Additionally, we offer administrative appeals to ensure you have every opportunity to defend your case.

services.title: Corporate and Worker Advisory
topics: Obtaining authorizations for foreign professionals to work legally in Portugal.
Advisory services for companies hiring foreign labor.
services.description: Advisory services for companies hiring foreign labor. Our team can help you understand the processes and requirements for hiring foreign labor in Portugal, ensuring you have all the necessary information for legal and secure hiring.

services.title: International Protection and Asylum
topics: Guidance for refugees and asylum seekers.
Legal process for obtaining humanitarian protection.
services.description: Guidance for refugees and asylum seekers. Our team can help you understand the processes and requirements for obtaining international protection and asylum in Portugal, ensuring you have all the necessary information for a successful application.

services.title: Fiscal and Legal Regularization
topics: Support in obtaining the NIF (Tax Identification Number).
Registration with Social Security for access to benefits and rights.
services.description: Support in obtaining the NIF (Tax Identification Number). Our team can help you understand the processes and requirements for obtaining the NIF and registering with Social Security in Portugal, ensuring you have all the necessary information for smooth fiscal and legal integration.

introduction.title: 1. Introduction
introduction.content:
This Privacy Policy describes how The Attorney (hereinafter "Firm"), based in Portugal, collects, uses, stores and protects the personal data of its clients, potential clients, partners and users of our website, in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 – General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and applicable national legislation.

The Firm is committed to protecting the privacy and confidentiality of the information entrusted to us.

dataCollected.title: 2. Personal Data Collected
dataCollected.intro: The Firm may collect and process the following personal data:

items.label: Identification
items.text: full name, date of birth, nationality, identification document number (ID/passport).

items.label: Data necessary for the provision of legal services
items.text: information related to legal proceedings, contracts, documents and other relevant information.

items.label: Website browsing data
items.text: IP address, approximate geographic location, cookies, browsing history (when applicable and with consent).

purposes.title: 3. Processing Purposes
purposes.intro: The personal data collected is processed for the following purposes:
items: Provision of legal services and legal advice.
Compliance with legal and regulatory obligations applicable to the practice of law.
Communication of information related to the services provided.
Improvement of the website user experience.

legalBasis.title: 4. Legal Basis
legalBasis.intro: The processing of personal data by the Firm is based on:
items: Performance of a contract or pre-contractual measures (Article 6(1)(b) GDPR).
Consent of the data subject, when applicable (Article 6(1)(a) GDPR).
Legitimate interests of the Firm (Article 6(1)(f) GDPR), namely for administrative management purposes and service improvement.

dataSharing.title: 5. Data Sharing
dataSharing.intro: The Firm does not share personal data with third parties, except when:
items: It is necessary to comply with legal obligations.
The data subject has given express consent.
Sharing is necessary for the provision of services (e.g., courts, regulatory entities or professional partners), always ensuring confidentiality.

dataRetention.title: 6. Data Retention
dataRetention.content: Personal data is retained only for the period necessary for the purposes of processing or for the time required by law and regulations applicable to the legal profession and its practice.

rights.title: 7. Data Subject Rights
rights.intro: Under applicable legislation, the data subject has the following rights:
items: Right of access to their personal data.
Right to rectification of inaccurate or incomplete data.
Right to erasure of data ("right to be forgotten"), when applicable.
Right to withdraw consent, when processing is based on this ground.
rights.footer: To exercise their rights, the data subject should contact the Firm through the means indicated below.

security.title: 8. Security
security.content: The Firm adopts appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect personal data against unauthorized access, loss, disclosure or destruction, ensuring the confidentiality and integrity of information.

cookies.title: 9. Cookies
cookies.content: Our website may use cookies to improve the user experience. The use of cookies will always be preceded by user consent, in accordance with applicable legislation.

contact.title: 10. Contact
contact.intro: If you have any questions or wish to exercise your rights, you can contact us through:

authority.title: 11. Supervisory Authority
authority.content: The data subject also has the right to lodge a complaint with the National Data Protection Commission (CNPD), the supervisory authority in Portugal.

changes.title: 12. Changes to the Privacy Policy
changes.content: The Firm may update this Privacy Policy at any time. Any changes will be published on the website with the respective update date.
